rule: Wherever rewards show, the today number and the 30 days sit next to it: scanner "Rewards $35 · Save $35 for 30 days · Use today $28 off"; register "Use $28 today, or save $35?"; receipt "Rewards earned $35 · Cover $10 · Saved $25, use by Nov 19" and both balances. Never "$35" alone.
title: Both numbers, every time
